error.csrf: Invalid CSRF token — reload the page.
error.env_open: Cannot open :path for writing: :detail. Check that the directory is writable by the web server user.
error.env_truncated: The .env file is truncated after writing (:n bytes).
error.db_access_denied: The MySQL user is not allowed to connect from the web server (:host).
error.db_check_firewall: Check that the service is running and that the firewall allows port :port.
error.db_back_to_step2: Go back to step 2 to check your credentials.
error.db_exists: ⚠️ The database « :name » already exists and contains :count table(s).

error.db_create_failed: The database « :name » does not exist and could not be created (insufficient privileges).

error.sql_fatal: blocking SQL error(s) during schema import:
error.env_write_perms: Cannot write the .env file — check the directory permissions.
error.incomplete_expired: Incomplete installation data — the session has expired.
error.installer_reset: The installer has been reset, please start again from step 1.
error.env_unreadable: The .env file is not found or unreadable after writing (size=:size, owner=:owner).
error.env_owner_hint: Common cause: the web server user does not have permissions on :dir.

error.incomplete_session: Incomplete installation data — the session has expired or was corrupted.
guard.remove_lock: Delete install.lock to run the installer again.
guard.recovery_warning: The install.lock file exists, but .env is missing or unreadable. The installer remains available to repair the configuration.
